# FG-GIT-0004

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `concurrency_limit_reports_git_busy` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: Git の処理が混み合っています。しばらくしてから再度お試しください。
- en: The Git backend is busy. Try again later.
- id: Layanan Git sedang sibuk. Coba lagi nanti.

## 原因 (cause)

Every git subprocess slot was in use for longer than the acquire timeout, or a principal (or a repository's browse cap) had no free slot within its short bounded wait (`git.http.busy_wait_ms`, default 5 s) or its wait queue was full.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Without `reason`: the captured pool (`GitConfig::max_concurrency`). `reason=streams`: the streaming pool for Smart HTTP (`max_streams`, default 16) — long clones hold slots. `reason=principal_streams`: one principal (user or client address) already has `max_per_principal` (default 4) streams open and none ended within `git.http.busy_wait_ms` (default 5 s; `queue=timeout`, `waited_ms`) or `max_waiters` (16) of its streams already wait (`queue=full`, at once; 2026-11-17 load test F4 — before, refused at once). The 503 carries `Retry-After: 1` (`retry_after_s`); git shows `HTTP 503`. A shared account, a CI bot or a bulk push from one PC: raise `git.http.max_streams_per_principal` or give each bot its own token. A push's own ref snapshot and commit listing count against a separate key of the principal, never against its push streams (a failed snapshot from this cause was FG-GIT-0016 `snapshot_failed cause_code=FG-GIT-0004`, fixed 2026-11-17). `reason=body_reads` / `principal_body_reads` (forge-web, M1 phase 9 MR3): every Smart HTTP request-body read slot is taken (sized like the stream pool: `git.http.max_streams` in total, waited for up to `acquire_timeout`, `wait_ms`) or this user already reads `git.http.max_streams_per_principal` bodies and none ended within `git.http.busy_wait_ms` (`max`, `queue=timeout|full`, `Retry-After: 1`) — many slow or stalled uploads at the same time. `reason=repo_browse` (with `repo_id`, `max_per_repo`, `queue`, `waited_ms`, `max_waiters`; M2 MR7): one repository already runs `BrowseLimits::max_per_repo` (default 8) captured browse calls and none ended within `BrowseLimits::repo_wait` (`git.http.busy_wait_ms`, 5 s, never past the operation's 10 s deadline; `queue=timeout`) or `max_repo_waiters` (64) calls already wait (`queue=full`, at once). Merge request creation (`POST …/merge-requests`, the source and target branch check) and edits with a new target use it, so many merge requests opened on one repository at once wait here (2026-11-17 load test F1; before, refused at once, e.g. request_id 1c4efb07…). The answer carries `Retry-After: 1` — with `check=reachability` it was the check that a commit named by id is reachable (M3 P6): not treated as reachable, logged as `forge.git.browse.reach_undecided` and answered to the user as FG-REPO-0023 `ref_not_found` (`reach_error=FG-GIT-0004`). `reason=caller_reach_rate` (with `burst`, `refill_ms`) / `reason=caller_reach` (with `max`, `wait_ms`): one caller made more commit-id browse lookups than its token bucket allows (`BrowseLimits::reach_caller_burst` 60, one back per `reach_caller_refill` 250 ms) or already runs `reach_per_caller` (2) of them and none finished within `reach_caller_wait` (2 s) — counted before the id is looked at, so missing and existing ids are refused alike (M3 P6, ADR-0024 #37). Usually a script walking commit ids; the UI browses by branch name. Compare with the number of concurrent clones/pushes in the access log.

## 対処 (fix)

Raise the git concurrency limit if the host has CPU and IO headroom, or find the operations that hold slots for long.
